R4F-bear-drive-0003.name: 170 m N of Goldstream River
R4F-bear-drive-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4F-bear-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Sec A Sweeper Main (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 250 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire N41889), 260 m NE: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 12 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Goldstream River 170 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
